description: This file defines the AnthropicPassthroughLoggingHandler class, which manages logging, response transformation, batch handling, and cost tracking for Anthropic LLM passthrough endpoints within the larger application. It includes methods for processing responses, handling batch creation, and storing associated metadata for cost management.
